subject: Error when using deployApp(): Unhandled Exception: Child Task failed: Error building image

messages.author: ae4e01c9cf4da161
messages.subject: Error when using deployApp(): Unhandled Exception: Child Task failed: Error building image
parts:
Hi all,


We’re trying to post our first shiny app and getting the following error:

Error: Unhandled Exception: Child Task 539727854 failed: Error building image: Error building units (0.6-0). Build exited with non-zero status: 1

 

I saw here that these types of error sometimes refer to dependencies failure.


Any help would be greatly appreciated! 

Almog

messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: Error when using deployApp(): Unhandled Exception: Child Task failed: Error building image
parts:
Correct, the package units depends upon libudunits2-dev.

Given the number of times I have seen this for units in the past couple of weeks, I will open up an issue myself.

But in general, see the documentation regarding system packages.
